text_block_list.text: I'm wandering the school grounds when I bump into Biwa Hayahide, who looks quite ill.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha… Not exactly. I have a slight headache.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I checked the weather reports thinking a change in barometric pressure triggered it, but there haven't been any major fluctuations recently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm experiencing fatigue and intermittent pain as well, so it's likely a migraine, but I can't rule out other pathologies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I compared my symptoms against other illnesses to be cautious, but the more I think about it, the more my head hurts…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: You're overthinking again. Take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're right… I recall reading a study that mentioned the importance of resting your nerves.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Ngh… I just can't seem to settle down.
Biwa Hayahide's seems to really be overthinking her headache…
